In which of the following processes entropy increases? A. A liquid evaporates to vapour. B.
Temperature of a crystalline solid lowered from 130 K to 0 K. C. 2NaHCO3(s) → Na2CO3(s) +
CO2(g) + H2O(g) D. Cl2(g) → 2Cl(g) Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
(1)
A and C
(2)
A, B and D
(3)
A, C and D
(4)
C and D
Thermodynamics
subject: Chemistry
b6_reason: Evaporation (A), solid decomposing to two gases (C) and Cl2 splitting into 2 Cl atoms (D) all raise disorder; cooling a crystal to 0 K (B) lowers entropy.
b6_working: A: liquid to vapour, dS > 0. B: dS = -q/T on cooling, entropy falls toward zero at 0 K, so dS < 0. C: 1 mol solid gives 1 mol solid + 2 mol gas, dn(gas) = +2, dS > 0. D: 1 mol gas gives 2 mol gas, dn(gas) = +1, dS > 0. So A, C, D.
